notes.title: Exciting news: Monkey Tag Arena Goes Free on March 14th!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Monkey Tag Arena will be completely free to play starting March 14th! This major update is our way of welcoming new players and thanking our loyal fans for their incredible support.

What this means for you:

Free Access: Dive into the adventure without any cost.
Enhanced Community: Enjoy richer multiplayer experiences and new in-game events.
Ongoing Updates: We're committed to rolling out new content, improvements, and surprises to keep the game evolving.
We believe that opening the game up to everyone will bring even more passion and creativity to our community. Whether you're a returning veteran or new to Monkey Tag Arena, there's never been a better time to jump in.

Thank you for joining us on this journey. Stay tuned for more details on upcoming events and new features. We can't wait to see you in-game!

Sincerely,
The Monkey Tag Arena Development Team
